mainText: Hello, Verona! At 3 AM, here is today's balanced dish: it is 57 degrees at the Verona Public Library under overcast skies. There is no visible ISS pass to look for in the sky tonight, though we do have a Waxing Gibbous moon.

The City Clerk's office reports that the student I Voted sticker contest is now closed. Residents can look forward to voting for the winning designs from July 28 through August 7. Also, the Public Works department reminds residents to inspect mailboxes before the plow season to avoid damage.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Live Music at Bailey's Run and Wisconsin Brewing Company are both happening today. Tomorrow, you can check out the Dane County Farmers' Market at the Capitol or enjoy music at Paddy Mac's.
In our weekly police update, officers reported that on Sunday July 13, a 36-year-old Madison man was arrested for an O-W-I after his vehicle became stuck on a rock.
Satisfy your sweet tooth with today's Chocolate Volcano flavor. The store is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you miss out today, tomorrow's flavor will be Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough.
